{{Image}}
The '''micro-optics''' module was a sensor array of several optical sensors that saw changes in substances at the molecular level. This high level of detail allowed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to more accurately identify perilous conditions in the immediate environment.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
